programme.desc: Daddy Puts Up A Picture: Mummy Pig has a nice new picture of Peppa and George. Daddy Pig offers to put it up, but the job is not as simple as he thought and soon there is a very big hole in the wall.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: At The Beach: Peppa and George love going to the beach on sunny days. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and their buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Mister Skinnylegs: George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa doesn't like spiders and screams very loudly. But soon she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Grandpa Pig's Boat: Granny and Grandpa Pig have a beautiful little boat, and today Peppa and George are spending the day on the river with them. Danny Dog and Granddad Dog are there as well.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Shopping: Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket. George sits in the trolley, while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list. Daddy Pig picks up something not on the list.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: My Birthday Party: It's Peppa Pig's birthday today. She wakes up very early so that none of her special day is wasted. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks, and makes a birthday cake appear!

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: Daisy & Poppy Go Bananas: Granny Thistle comes to visit and gives Daisy and Poppy a powerful magical wand. The children escape from the castle and... go bananas!

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: Lucy's School: Holly and Ben spend a day at Lucy's school, whilst trying not to be spotted by Lucy's teacher, Miss Cookie.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: Plumbing: The bath tap at the Little Castle is dripping, so the elf plumber is called. It's a bigger job than first expected, but with King and Queen Marigolds coming round, there's not much time!

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: The Party: It's the twins' birthday party and chaos ensues when their little friends arrive. The Wise Old Elf tries to entertain them, but they turn him into a mouse!

programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.title: Bedtime Stories with Ryan

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Bigger House: With a new baby on the way, Mummy and Daddy Pig realise they have run out of space at home! They decide to make their own home bigger with an extension. (S8, ep 1)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Calling Kylie: It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn it's not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the earth.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Folk Music Band: Peppa and George are in Granny and Grandpa Pig's Garden. Granny's friends are playing folk music! They play music for Grandpa Pig and then Grandpa Pig makes apple juice for everyone!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Hot Dry Day: Peppa and George are playing in their pool. They help the garden animals cool down but when it rains, the animals are happy and so is Peppa. Rain makes muddy puddles for jumping in!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Indoor Adventure: A storm cancels Peppa and her family's adventure plans so they decide to take it inside. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and have a campfire in the attic.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: New TV: Peppa and family are watching TV... until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything... but it doesn't beat their old TV.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Staying Up Late: Auntie, Uncle Pig and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late - she even stayed up later than the Daddies!

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Cushion Den: On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: Daisy and Poppy: Holly and her friends must stay in the courtyard and play with Holly's little twin sisters Daisy and Poppy. All is fine until the twins borrow a magic wand and escape from the castle!

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: Uncle Gaston: Three baby ladybirds, Amber, Emerald and Keith have come to stay at Uncle Gaston's for the day. The baby ladybirds are exhausting! So Ben and Holly help Gaston to keep them entertained.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programme.desc: Seeking a Safer Sodor: When Percy and Kana have a near-collision because they're distracted, they blame insufficient safety measures. (S2, ep 44)

programme.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programme.desc: A Cranky Goodbye: When Bulstrode and Cranky get into their crankiest fight yet, they have to learn how to express their feelings in order to save their sinking friendship. (S2, ep 45)

programme.title: DORA
programme.desc: Dora helps Swiper find his duplicates for a picnic in 'Too Many Swipers', and in 'Bateo's Home Run', Dora helps Bateo get to the baseball game. (S2, ep 10)

programme.desc: Dinerstore: Tim and Tommy help out at the DinerStore. (S1, ep 42)

programme.title: Tim Rex in Space
programme.desc: Hat: When Grandma gives Tim a hat she made herself, Tim is super excited, but unfortunately it keeps getting in the way. (S1, ep 45)

programme.title: The Adventures of Paddington

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Wedding Day: It's the day of Mrs Cow and Mr Bull's wedding! Not everything goes to plan, but that doesn't stop it being the best wedding ever, and there is a lot of happy crying! (S7, ep 16)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Party Bus: Peppa receives an invite to Candy Cat's birthday party - on a double decker bus! (S7, ep 17)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Movie Night: Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night. But before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, and which popcorn to eat. (S7, ep 18)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Art House Day: Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day. After a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds the perfect artwork. (S7, ep 19)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Wildflower Wood: Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers. The children enjoy identifying Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even an orchid! (S7, ep 20)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Sunny Day Games: Peppa and George are playing at their grandparent's garden on a very hot day but they don't have a paddling pool! (S7, ep 21)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Magic Trick: Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party, and Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works. (S7, ep 22)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Jumping Stick: Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick and tries to show how to use it, but finds it difficult. Peppa and her friends struggle too. But there's always jumping in muddy puddles! (S7, ep 23)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Racquet Games: Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere! So, the children play badminton instead and it's a lot easier. (S7, ep 24)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Adventure Caravan: Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure and the first stop is The Biggest Potato in the World. When it starts to get foggy, they park up before another busy day. (S7, ep 25)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Caravan Friends: After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car! Luckily, the bear family stop it just in time. (S7, ep 26)

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Chloe's Birthday Party: At Chloe's party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the obstacle course to reach the prize. George is the last to try and finds the birthday cake! (S7, ep 27)

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: The Elf Farm: Holly goes with Ben and Mr Elf to the elf farm to collect an egg for the King's breakfast. While there, a huge chicken escapes from the farm and Holly and the elves have to chase it!
